ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes; heavy black mottling and stippling concentrated along the trailing edges; a prominent dark vertical column of low-intensity pixels extending from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged; the left lobe distal edge shows extreme amplitude variations due to secondary mass attachments; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits consistent micro-serrations with frequent 10-20 pixel amplitude shifts.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; left lobe trajectory is heavily distorted by localized pixel clusters at the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast white-and-tan pixel blobs on the far-left distal tip; scattered small white circular spots visible on the upper-right interior lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally within the dark central region below the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the upper-left trailing edge tip creating a distinct irregular silhouette; multiple unaligned linear scars in the central fluke region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique protrusion of organic material/encrustation on the left fluke tip significantly altering the geometric boundary compared to the right tip.
